content.title: Kansas Jayhawk Fans
content.text: Coach Self reportedly made some big lifestyle changes following his health scare this past summer: limited his alcohol intake, increased exercise, and stopped eating red meat/fast food/yellow cheese/sweets. The healthier lifestyle has led to him dropping 20 pounds and feeling like a whole new man heading into this season.“I’m as thirsty to win as I ever was. I’m probably a little more energized and rejuvenated now because my body actually feels better. I feel like I can attack this season more aggressively than the last couple of years.”Keep taking care of yourself, Coach! All reactions:Ryan GaroutteLet’s see about the alcohol intake the first month of conference play. That is where the real test begins.13Top fanJohn DooleyWish he ate only red meat and eggs with butter and salt. He would feel like he was 18 again.11Clay TiceYellow cheese? I get why cutting back dairy can help but why yellow cheese specifically?2Top fanRemy Kulick-HartWell, this team already looks better than the last couple years and I’ve noticed his weight loss. Glad to hear all this. The way he built this specific roster is much different than the 2024 & 2025 rosters. We also have the best recruit we’ve had in years so there are several key differences about this current season compared to the last two and I think it’s for the better in every way. Especially the changes that Coach Self has made with himself. Him being more healthy physically and mentally I know will bring out the best parts of his coaching abilities in a much more positive & consistent way compared to last year9Top fanPuett RLEating unsalted almonds and walnuts are also low fat protein, which will keep you healthy.Jacob DaviesNo red meat, pretty standard for lawrencites3Karl Stephen PageHe should call Mangino and give him some advice3Stephen OrthIs yellow cheese worse for you than white cheese? ￼
